stories.title: El Gobierno de Ayuso renuncia a cobrar casi 60 millones de euros a las empresas privadas que explotarán residencias en parcelas públicas

en.title: Ayuso's Government Renounces Collecting Nearly 60 Million Euros from Private Companies Operating Care Homes on Public Land
en.summary: Madrid's regional government will not apply an annual fee it is entitled to collect over a 70-year concession period for private companies operating residential facilities on public parcels, citing its requirement that operators provide non-commercial public places.

stories.title: Todo sobre la espuma de la cerveza: su verdadero nombre y cinco marcas de supermercado para practicar en casa

en.title: Everything About Beer Foam: Its Real Name and Five Supermarket Brands to Practice at Home
en.summary: The Spanish language has a specific term for beer foam called giste, and the article identifies five supermarket beer brands suitable for home experimentation.

stories.title: Sánchez ignora el 'no' de Junts y confirma que el Gobierno aprobará este martes un decreto ley con «propuestas» de sus socios

en.title: Sánchez Ignores Junts' 'No' and Confirms Government Will Approve Decree Law with 'Proposals' from Allies on Tuesday
en.summary: Spanish President Sánchez announced the government will approve a decree law on Tuesday addressing housing emergency measures, proceeding despite Junts withdrawing from negotiations with the executive.

stories.title: El Gobierno quiere prorrogar dos años los alquileres y prohibir los desahucios hasta 2028

en.title: Government seeks to extend rental agreements for two years and ban evictions until 2028
en.summary: The government plans to present a housing decree to cabinet aimed at addressing housing emergency concerns, following a recent eviction case that sparked public reaction.

stories.title: El Gobierno renuncia a otros 1.260 millones de fondos europeos en su petición final a la UE del Plan de Recuperación

en.title: Government Renounces Additional 1.26 Billion Euros in European Funds in Final Recovery Plan Request to EU
en.summary: Spain's government is relinquishing over 1.26 billion euros in its latest modification to the EU, bringing total abandoned EU recovery plan loan funds to more than 61.7 billion euros.

stories.title: Urbagestión llega a un acuerdo con los representantes de Maricarmen para que vuelva a su casa

en.title: Urbagestión reaches agreement with Maricarmen's representatives for her return home
en.summary: The property company agreed to allow an 87-year-old woman to return to her Madrid apartment at approximately 500 euros monthly rent, pending her approval of the terms.

stories.title: Negociación de vértigo para pactar un decreto de vivienda que habría sido imposible sin Maricarmen

en.title: Intense negotiations to reach housing decree agreement that would have been impossible without Maricarmen
en.summary: Left-wing parties and other political groups are negotiating terms of housing protections legislation, with various demands on eviction protections and rental contracts, though consensus appears possible.

stories.title: El Papa, sobre Maricarmen: “¿Cuál es el problema en el sistema que permite que una anciana sea echada de su casa?”

en.title: The Pope on Maricarmen: "What is the problem in the system that allows an elderly woman to be evicted from her home?"
en.summary: The Pope commented to press about evictions, acknowledging he was unaware of the specific case, and called for more just solutions and investigation into the systemic causes of the problem.

stories.title: Maricarmen y Urbagestión alcanzan un acuerdo para que la anciana vuelva a su casa

en.title: Maricarmen and Urbagestión reach an agreement for the elderly woman to return to her home
en.summary: Municipal housing authorities mediated negotiations that resulted in an agreement allowing an elderly woman to return to her residence, pending her validation of the terms.

stories.title: El Gobierno plantea a los socios prohibir los desahucios a personas vulnerables hasta 2028 y prorrogar dos años los alquileres

en.title: Government proposes to partners banning evictions of vulnerable people until 2028 and extending rental contracts by two years
en.summary: The Housing Ministry has drafted a proposal to limit rental contract updates to 2% annually and introduce tax deductions for tenants in high-demand areas, while preventing evictions of vulnerable households through 2028.

stories.title: El Gobierno aprobará una prórroga de hasta dos años de los contratos de alquiler y eleva las rebajas fiscales para inquilinos

en.title: The Government will approve an extension of up to two years for rental contracts and increases tax deductions for tenants
en.summary: The Government will approve measures to extend rental contracts for up to two years and increase tax deductions for tenants. It will also restore savings accounts for first-time homebuyers and enable loans for housing down payments.

stories.title: Los cinco interrogantes del caso Maricarmen sobre el acuerdo para que vuelva a su casa

en.title: Five questions in the Maricarmen case regarding an agreement for her to return home
en.summary: The elderly woman's lawyer, property representatives, and municipal mediators met to negotiate an agreement regarding the return of an elderly resident to her residence.

stories.title: Peugeot producirá en Vigo la nueva generación del Partner y el 2008

en.title: Peugeot will produce the new generation of Partner and 2008 in Vigo
en.summary: Peugeot's CEO confirms that Stellantis plants in Vigo and Zaragoza will continue manufacturing four Peugeot models in the future.

stories.title: La hija de Sol Daurella entra en el consejo de Cobega

en.title: Sol Daurella's daughter joins Cobega's board
en.summary: Sol Vilarrubí Daurella joins the board of Cobega, the holding company that indirectly controls 37% of Coca-Cola Europacific Partners.

stories.title: Javier Quirós toma el relevo en Grupo Cañadío

en.title: Javier Quirós takes over at Grupo Cañadío
en.summary: Javier Quirós, son of founder Paco Quirós, joins the management team of the restaurant group.

stories.title: Las líneas de IoT se triplican en dos años por las balizas V16

en.title: IoT lines triple in two years due to V16 beacons
en.summary: The number of mobile lines connecting machines increased from 17 million to 57 million over a two-year period.

stories.title: Mutua Madrid Horse Week regresa con tres Copas del Mundo y nuevo patrocinador

en.title: Mutua Madrid Horse Week returns with three World Cups and new sponsor
en.summary: The equestrian event returns to IFEMA from November 26-29 after a one-year absence, adding a third World Cup competition and securing Mutua Madrileña as primary sponsor.
